```{r}
library("tidyverse")

xy <- seq(from = -3,
          to = 3, 
          by = 0.01)
expand_grid(x = xy,
            y = xy) |>
  ggplot(
    mapping = aes(
      x = (1 + x - sin(y^2)),
      y = (1 - y - cos(x^2)))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.05,
             shape = 20,
             size = 0) + 
  theme_void() +
  coord_polar()
```
